articles.title: The Millrace Library Branch Plans Community Oven for Spring
articles.deck: Residents of Hickory Ridge met on Saturday to talk over the plan.
body: Anyone interested can attend the next planning meeting at the Hickory Ridge rec center on Saturday at 7 p.m. The group has raised $18,500 so far and is asking for help with supplies and food.

Organizers say the work is on schedule and that volunteers are still needed on Saturday mornings. The effort began in February when a handful of neighbors met at the Hickory Ridge rec center to talk about community oven.

Several residents on Hickory Ridge Road said they had been waiting since 1999 for something like this. Mildred Sandoval, who has lived on Hickory Ridge Road for 18 years, said the response has been better than anyone expected.

articles.title: Letter: Support the Pet Adoption Fair
body: To the editor: Please keep the pet adoption fair in the budget. Many of us on Franklin Avenue use it every week. To the editor: I have lived on Franklin Avenue for 40 years, and I want to say what a difference the Marsh Landing Pond Committee has made.
I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the May meeting. Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
Please keep the pet adoption fair in the budget. Many of us on Franklin Avenue use it every week.
Talia Novak, Stonebridge

articles.title: Angela Kaczmarek, 76, Machinist
articles.deck: Friends remember Angela Kaczmarek for the many years of service to Foundry Row.
body: Angela Kaczmarek died in January at home on Laurel Drive, at the age of 76.

Born in Foundry Row in the years after the war, Angela Kaczmarek spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood. Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Kettle Hill Block Association in his or her name.
Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Foundry Row. Angela Kaczmarek died in January at home on Laurel Drive, at the age of 76.
